description: This remote-sensing inventory locates 6,924 offshore wind turbines across more than ten countries using Sentinel-1 observations from 2015 to 2019. The research team provides WGS84 Shapefiles with turbine centroid coordinates, country, continent, sea area and appearance year and month. A validation collection covers 50 wind farms and 2,663 turbines. Figshare version 10 distributes a ZIP package under CC0 with free access, and describes 10-metre source imagery. The inventory can initialize offshore-asset exposure or capacity scenarios, complementing data-ea-owt-east-asia-offshore-wind-turbines. A caveat is that satellite-detected appearance dates are not necessarily commercial commissioning dates, and point locations do not provide every turbine's electrical rating or grid connection. The latest archive filename mentions 2021, but the own description still states 2015–2019; no later observation period is assumed. The Shapefiles and validation imagery were not downloaded and turbine counts were not recomputed.
